meaning:
ἐξ-εγείρω
[in LXX for עוּר ni., hi., etc. ;]
to raise up: Rom.9:17 (cf. ICC, in l); from the dead, 1Co.6:14.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: For the Scripture says to Pharaoh, “For this very purpose I caused you to be raised up, that I might show in you my power, and that my name might be proclaimed…
Now God raised up the Lord, and will also raise us up by his power.
